title: KAITO — Cool Blue Melody〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone.
My name is KAITO. Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks for that rousing welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I heard some of you here have never met us before. I'm glad you seem to be enjoying yourselves still!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, maybe I should do a quick introduction of myself before we start.
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm... I see...
A simple self-introduction like this can be effective too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The main part is the song that comes later, in which case, it would be best to keep the introduction simple...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naaargh?! You again, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop suddenly jumping out from behind like that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe, did it make your heart go badump-badump?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It badumped so hard I almost dumped my smartphone onto the floor...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey!
You're watching a VIRTUAL SINGER live show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Do you ever listen to what anyone says?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh. Never mind. You should watch and learn too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Learn what?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just watch and you'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well? Understand now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The stage isn't particularly gorgeous, and they're wearing their usual outfits.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yet, you can really feel their presence!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is it the stage effects?
Or because they're just that good? Doesn't it make you wonder?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm... Speaking of things that make me wonder...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did you discover something useful from the video too? Go on, share it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why does KAITO wear a scarf?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I was a fool to believe it would be anything good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: KAITO's been around for a while, and now you wonder?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, but MEIKO's clothes look so cooling, right? Yet KAITO wears a scarf and a coat...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gasp! Is he like...super afraid of the cold?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGERS don't feel cold...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The scarf's something like KAITO's trademark anyway. It's normal for him to be seen in it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Trademark?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! Just like it's normal for pandas to have black eyes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Pandas are born with black eyes, though?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks, KAITO!
I had a great time singing with you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too! It's been a while since we sang together like this. It was a pleasure indeed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we call everyone back out to the stage?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's all come together to make things livelier than before!
